description: This Java class 'RequestWrapper' extends HttpServletRequestWrapper to allow multiple reads of the request body by caching the input stream bytes. It provides overridden methods getReader() and getInputStream() to return buffered streams from the cached bytes, facilitating request data inspection or modification.

classes.name: RequestWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletRequest that caches the request body bytes to allow multiple reads.

methods.name: RequestWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing with the original HttpServletRequest.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader over the cached request bytes.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream over the cached request bytes.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Reads and caches the request body bytes from the original request input stream.
